I told Marcus in the #north-team thread that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 25 November.

That date comes only from Ilse's message in #north-team on 14 October. Marcus is in that channel, so it was fine to repeat it to him. I looked for Brackenwater account files in the shared files to confirm the date but found none, and I said so in my reply. If the account sheet needs a firmer source than Ilse's message, someone will have to find the contract or CRM record.
